svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 水滴石穿 (traditional 水滴石穿), shuǐ dī shí chuān, “Dripping water bores through stone”. Small daily commits outlast heroic weekends. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.

g.text: Small daily commits outlast heroic weekends.
